# The Haki of Kings

[All quest chapters](index.md)

<a id="q-3447ed350dc93c8e"></a>

## Born a King

Conqueror's Haki has a base birth chance of 5%. Those born with it can awaken it naturally in a crisis, or take a mentor's short King's Test. Their Conqueror's mastery grows 1.5× as fast.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Be born with Conqueror's Haki

**Rewards**

- Doriki +300, Belly +20,000

<a id="q-7b26edb42ad925b0"></a>

## The Will of a King

Most who command the Haki of kings were born with it. A few forged a will strong enough to stand beside theirs.

Sail the New World, raise your Armament and Observation to 70% of their limit, beat Rayleigh, and beat an Emperor or an Admiral (Whitebeard, Big Mom, Blackbeard, Aokiji, Kizaru or Akainu). Then your Conqueror's Haki is there to be woken.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Sail the New World
- Armament and Observation at 70% of their limit
- Beat Rayleigh
- Beat an Emperor or an Admiral

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +100,000, Haki +10 Busoshoku / +10 Kenbunshoku

<a id="q-2a6acb105444da72"></a>

## The Haki of Kings

Ask a Haki mentor such as Rayleigh at Sabaody for the King's Test. Stand your ground against the mentor for 60 seconds after qualifying through The Will of a King, or 15 seconds if you were born with it. Keep your health above the blackout threshold of 10%.

An additional secret unlock condition is open to any player.

**Prerequisites (any of)** — [Born a King](h_kings.md#q-3447ed350dc93c8e), [The Will of a King](h_kings.md#q-7b26edb42ad925b0)

**Tasks**

- Awaken Conqueror's Haki

**Rewards**

- Doriki +1,200, Belly +150,000, Golden Box
